# SPARCED Original Paper (Erdem 2022)

This page outlines the steps taken to replicate the results from
[_A scalable, open-source implementation of a large-scale mechanistic model for single cell proliferation and death signaling_](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-022-31138-1)
by Cemal Erdem et al., published in 2022.
It includes details on the experimental setup, data preprocessing, code execution, and any deviations or clarifications needed to match the original findings.
